text:
## Decision Authority Matrix  
| Decision Type | Authority | Limit | Escalation |
|---|---|---|---|
| Fee Reversal | Manager | £1,000 | Director if >£1k |
| Complaint Resolution | Manager | £5,000 | CRO if >£5k |
| Fraud Reimbursement | Compliance | £10,000 | CEO if >£10k |
| KYC Exception | Compliance Head | Any | CRO if PEP/sanctions |
| Product Exception | Product Manager | £50,000 | Board if >£50k |
| Lending Exception | Underwriter | Credit policy | CRO if policy violation |
| System Expenditure | CTO | £50,000 | CFO if >£50k |
| Vendor Contract | Department Head | £100,000 | CEO if >£100k |

raw_entities.name: Decision Authority Matrix Process
raw_entities.description: A governance framework defining the financial limits and authority levels for approving various banking exceptions, reimbursements, and expenditures. It specifies the primary authority and the required escalation path based on monetary thresholds or risk factors.

raw_entities.name: Manager
raw_entities.description: An authority role responsible for approving fee reversals up to £1,000 and complaint resolutions up to £5,000.

raw_entities.name: Director
raw_entities.description: The escalation authority for fee reversals exceeding the £1,000 manager limit.

raw_entities.name: Chief Risk Officer (CRO)
raw_entities.description: A senior executive authority who handles escalations for complaint resolutions over £5,000, KYC exceptions involving PEPs or sanctions, and lending policy violations.

raw_entities.name: Compliance
raw_entities.description: The functional role responsible for approving fraud reimbursements up to £10,000.

raw_entities.name: Chief Executive Officer (CEO)
raw_entities.description: The highest level of authority for fraud reimbursements exceeding £10,000 and vendor contracts exceeding £100,000.

raw_entities.name: Compliance Head
raw_entities.description: The primary authority responsible for approving KYC Exceptions of any value.

raw_entities.name: Product Manager
raw_entities.description: The authority responsible for approving product exceptions up to £50,000.

raw_entities.name: Board
raw_entities.description: The governing body that provides approval for product exceptions exceeding £50,000.

raw_entities.name: Underwriter
raw_entities.description: The role responsible for lending exceptions provided they adhere to the credit policy.

raw_entities.name: Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
raw_entities.description: The authority responsible for approving system expenditure up to £50,000.

raw_entities.name: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
raw_entities.description: The escalation authority for system expenditures exceeding £50,000.

raw_entities.name: Department Head
raw_entities.description: The authority responsible for signing vendor contracts up to £100,000.

raw_entities.name: Fee Reversal Authority Limit Check
raw_entities.description: A decision gate to determine if a fee reversal can be approved by a Manager (£1,000 limit) or must be escalated to a Director.

raw_entities.name: Complaint Resolution Authority Limit Check
raw_entities.description: A decision gate to determine if a complaint resolution can be approved by a Manager (£5,000 limit) or must be escalated to the CRO.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Reimbursement Authority Limit Check
raw_entities.description: A decision gate to determine if fraud reimbursement is within Compliance limits (£10,000) or requires CEO escalation.

raw_entities.name: KYC Exception Risk Gate
raw_entities.description: A decision gate where the Compliance Head approves standard exceptions, but PEP or sanctions-related exceptions are escalated to the CRO.
context: KYC Exception | Compliance Head | Any | CRO if PEP/sanctions

raw_entities.name: Product Exception Authority Limit Check
raw_entities.description: A decision gate determining if a product exception is within the Product Manager's £50,000 limit or requires Board approval.
context: Product Exception | Product Manager | £50,000 | Board if >£50k

raw_entities.name: Lending Policy Compliance Check
raw_entities.description: A check to see if a lending exception adheres to credit policy (approved by Underwriter) or violates it (escalated to CRO).
context: Lending Exception | Underwriter | Credit policy | CRO if policy violation

raw_entities.name: System Expenditure Authority Limit Check
raw_entities.description: A decision gate to check if system spend is within CTO limits (£50,000) or requires CFO escalation.

raw_entities.name: Vendor Contract Authority Limit Check
raw_entities.description: A decision gate to check if a vendor contract is within Department Head limits (£100,000) or requires CEO escalation.
context: Vendor Contract | Department Head | £100,000 | CEO if >£100k

properties.purpose: Define financial and operational approval limits for specific banking decisions
properties.scope: Operational expenditures, customer reimbursements, and policy exceptions
properties.outcome_success: Decision approved within authorized limits or correctly escalated

properties.approval_limit: Up to £1,000 for Fee Reversals; Up to £5,000 for Complaint Resolution
Any amount for standard KYC Exceptions

properties.decision_question: Is the fee reversal amount within the Manager's limit?
Is the complaint resolution amount within the Manager's limit?
Is the fraud reimbursement amount within Compliance's limit?
Does the KYC exception involve a PEP or sanctioned individual?
Is the product exception value within the Product Manager's limit?
Does the lending exception violate the credit policy?
Is the system expenditure within the CTO's limit?
Is the vendor contract value within the Department Head's limit?

relationships.description: The Decision Authority Matrix Process includes the Fee Reversal authority check.
The Decision Authority Matrix Process includes the Complaint Resolution authority check.
The Decision Authority Matrix Process includes the Fraud Reimbursement authority check.

Fee reversals up to £1,000 are decided by the Manager.
Fee reversals exceeding £1,000 are escalated to the Director.
Complaint resolutions up to £5,000 are decided by the Manager.
Complaint resolutions exceeding £5,000 are escalated to the CRO.
Fraud reimbursements up to £10,000 are decided by Compliance.
Fraud reimbursements exceeding £10,000 are escalated to the CEO.
KYC exceptions are initially decided by the Compliance Head.
KYC exceptions involving PEP or sanctions are escalated to the CRO.
